games.headline: Nuggets beat the Pacers 114-102 in Mexico City behind Nikola Jokic's 19 points
games.desc: — Nikola Jokic scored 10 of his 19 points in the first quarter and the Denver Nuggets beat the Indiana Pacers 114-102 in Mexico City.

games.headline: Jalen Johnson scores 30 points in his return as Hawks make 4th-quarter charge to beat Nets 124-121
games.desc: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker sank two free throws with 1:26 remaining to give Atlanta its first lead and the Hawks recovered from a big early deficit to beat the Brooklyn Nets 124-121 on Saturday night.

games.headline: Jalen Brunson scores 31 to power Knicks past Cavs 109-97 in rematch of last year's Eastern finalists
games.desc: — Jalen Brunson scored 31 points, Karl-Anthony Towns added 29 and the New York Knicks made big plays when they needed them in a 109-97 win over the Cleveland Cavaliers on Saturday night in a rematch between last year's Eastern Conference finalists.

games.headline: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Thunder rout the poor-shooting Wizards 114-75
games.desc: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 30 points in three quarters and the Oklahoma City Thunder routed poor-shooting Washington 114-75 on Saturday night, holding the Wizards to the lowest total in the NBA this season.

games.headline: Stephen Curry scores 41 points as Warriors win seventh straight, beating Magic 126-119 in overtime
games.desc: — Stephen Curry converted a three-point play with 1:38 left in overtime that put Golden State ahead then scored a layup in the final minute to finish with 41 points, six rebounds and six assists, and the Warriors held off the Orlando Magic 126-119 on...

games.headline: Booker scores 24, Suns outlast Rockets 102-99 for 1st back-to-back wins of season
games.desc: — Devin Booker scored 24 points, including seven straight to break a late tie, and the Phoenix Suns held off the Houston Rockets 102-99 on Saturday night.

games.headline: Victor Wembanyama scores 29 points in Spurs win over Blazers
games.desc: — Victor Wembanyama scored 29 points and led the San Antonio Spurs to a 125-103 blowout win over the Portland Trail Blazers on Saturday night.
